about.q1: What is Cargration and how does it work?
about.a1: Cargration is a Beijing & Guizhou-based vehicle export company that sources, inspects, documents, and ships Chinese vehicles to buyers in 42+ countries.
about.q2: How long has Cargration been in business?
about.a2: Cargration was founded in 2019 and has since grown to export over 12,400 vehicles annually. We have a team of 40+ multilingual specialists operating across Beijing and Guizhou, with established logistics partnerships covering 42 destination countries.
about.q3: Is Cargration a licensed and certified exporter?
about.a3: Yes. Cargration holds ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management certification, is a China Customs Licensed Exporter, CCPIT Certified for documentation, and holds IATA Cargo Agent Affiliation. All export documentation — commercial invoices, certificates of origin, and bills of lading — are prepared and verified before shipment.
about.q4: How does Cargration ensure vehicle quality?
about.a4: Every vehicle undergoes our 200-point inspection covering engine performance, brakes and suspension, electronics and diagnostics, body and paint condition, interior and upholstery, undercarriage inspection, and a full road test. Inspection reports with photos and video are shared with buyers before purchase.
about.q5: Does Cargration offer warranty on exported vehicles?
about.a5: New vehicles sourced from manufacturer-authorised Chinese dealers carry the full factory warranty, valid in markets where the brand has an official dealer network. For used vehicles and parallel imports, we offer a 30-day mechanical warranty covering engine, transmission, and major systems. Extended warranty options are available through our partner network at additional cost.
about.q6: Can I visit Cargration's facility in China?
about.a6: Absolutely. We have offices in both Beijing and Guizhou — two of China's largest used car markets. Our Beijing office is at 12-B2 Floor, Konggang Ronghuiyuan, Shunyi District. Our Guizhou hub is at Hepeng Village, Shiban Town, Huaxi District, Guiyang. Buyers are welcome to visit either location.
about.ctaSub: Whether you need a single vehicle or a fleet of 50, we handle the entire export process from sourcing to port loading.

ins.sub: Every Chinese car in our catalogue passes a 200-point inspection by Chaboshi 268V and Dongchedi — two of China's leading vehicle inspection platforms — before listing, can be re-inspected on demand, and is checked once more at the port before it ships.
ins.twoTitle: Inspected three times. Verified end to end.
ins.twoSub: No other exporter checks your vehicle at three independent moments. Here is how it works.
ins.s1d: Before a car enters our catalogue, Chaboshi 268V and Dongchedi independently run the full 200-point standard on it. Only vehicles that pass every checkpoint are listed.
ins.s1i1d: Two independent platforms evaluate every candidate vehicle against the full 200-point standard
ins.s1i2d: Compression, fluids, belts, turbo, transmission, and EV battery health diagnostics
ins.s1i3d: Paint thickness readings, panel gaps, corrosion, upholstery, and trim condition
ins.s1i4d: 100+ photos and a video walkaround attached to the listing
ins.s1i5d: Accident history, service records, and odometer cross-checks where available
ins.s1out: Only vehicles that pass all 200 checkpoints are added to the catalogue. Failures are rejected on the spot.
ins.s2d: Any buyer can order a fresh, up-to-date inspection of their exact vehicle at any time before purchase — with an independent 200-point report from Chaboshi 268V or Dongchedi, and live coverage if you want it.
ins.s2i1d: A brand-new inspection of your specific car, performed when you request it — never a stale report
ins.s2i2d: An independent 200-point report from the platform you select
ins.s2i3d: Watch the inspection live or review the full photo/video set
ins.s2i4d: Compression, paint meter, interior moisture, or undercarriage in any extra detail you need
ins.s2i5d: The verified 200-point report is delivered to you before any payment
ins.s2out: If the re-inspection reveals anything below standard, we fix it, replace the car, or refund — before you pay a cent.
ins.s3d: Before the container is sealed and loaded onto the vessel, the vehicle is inspected once more at the port — confirming it is the exact car you bought, damage-free and ship-ready.
ins.s3i1d: Full exterior and interior walkaround confirming no damage during transport or storage
ins.s3i2d: VIN, export documents, and bill of lading matched to the vehicle and your order
ins.s3i3d: An inspector witnesses and records the container loading and lashing
ins.s3i4d: Seal number photographed and shared with you for tracking integrity
ins.s3i5d: Final 200-point sign-off before the vessel departs
ins.s3out: The car is loaded, sealed, and documented. The seal number and loading photos are shared with you before departure.
ins.checkSub: Every inspection — before listing, on demand, or at the port — runs the full 200-point standard operated by Chaboshi 268V and Dongchedi.
ins.p1d: Compression test, fluid analysis, belt and hose inspection, turbo/supercharger health check, timing chain inspection, and cold-start evaluation.
ins.p2d: Brake pad thickness, rotor wear, caliper function, ABS sensor diagnostics, shock absorber dampening, bushing condition, and alignment check.
ins.p3d: OBD-II scan for all modules, battery load test, alternator output, AC system performance, infotainment function, sensor readings, and error memory.
ins.p4d: Panel gap measurement, paint thickness gauge (all panels), corrosion inspection, glass clarity, lighting function, and trim condition.
ins.p5d: Upholstery condition, electronics function (windows, seats, mirrors), HVAC performance, infotainment navigation test, and odometer accuracy.
ins.p6d: Frame straightness, subframe condition, exhaust system integrity, fuel line inspection, CV joint boots, and rust assessment.
ins.whyTitle: No exporter checks a car at three independent moments
ins.w1t: Only inspected cars enter the catalogue
ins.w1d: The pre-listing inspection by Chaboshi 268V and Dongchedi filters out substandard vehicles before you ever see them.
ins.w2d: The on-demand re-inspection gives you an up-to-date 200-point report on your exact vehicle — no surprises.
ins.w3t: A final gate at the port
ins.w3d: The pre-shipment inspection proves the car that leaves is the car you bought — damage-free and correctly loaded.
ins.w4d: All three inspections are performed by external platforms, independent of the sales process. No conflicts of interest.
ins.guar1: If a vehicle fails any of the three inspections, we do not ship it. Period.
ins.guar2: We source an alternative vehicle that meets our 200-point standard at no additional cost to you. If we cannot find a suitable replacement within 14 days, your deposit is fully refunded.
ins.guar3: This guarantee applies to every vehicle we export — whether it is a $3,000 used sedan or a $120,000 luxury SUV.
ins.q1: How long does each inspection take?
ins.a1: The pre-listing 200-point inspection typically takes 2–4 hours. On-demand re-inspections take 2–3 hours depending on the checks you request, and the port inspection about 1 hour including loading supervision.
ins.q2: Can I be present during the inspection?
ins.a2: Due to facility access restrictions, we cannot host buyers for the full inspection. However, we provide comprehensive photo and video documentation at every stage. You can also request a live video call during the inspection if you would like to see specific areas.
ins.q3: What happens if the vehicle fails an inspection?
ins.a3: We reject the vehicle and source an alternative that meets our 200-point standard at no cost to you. Our sourcing team begins searching for a replacement immediately and keeps you updated throughout the process.
ins.q4: What happens if the vehicle is damaged between inspections?
ins.a4: If the port inspection reveals new damage (sustained during domestic transport or handling), we document it fully and coordinate repairs or a replacement before shipping. All transit insurance claims are handled by our logistics team.
ins.a5: Yes. For EVs, we add battery health diagnostics (SoH/SoC), charging system test, thermal management check, high-voltage cable inspection, and OTA system verification to the standard 200-point process.
ins.q6: Can I request additional inspection items?
ins.a6: Yes. If you need specific checks beyond our standard 200-point inspection — such as a compression test, leak-down test, or paint thickness report on specific panels — we can arrange this at cost. Contact our team for details.
ins.ctaSub: Every vehicle in our inventory passed its 200-point pre-listing inspection and can be re-inspected on demand. Browse now or speak to our quality team.

pay.howSub: We operate on full advance payment via bank wire transfer. Once payment is confirmed, we proceed immediately with documentation, container loading, and shipping clearance.
pay.st1d: We issue a proforma invoice with the final FOB price, inspection fee, and shipping quote in your chosen currency.

pay.ratePolicy: Rates are locked on the date of the proforma invoice and held for 5 business days. If your transfer is initiated within this window, the quoted rate is guaranteed.
pay.bankSub: All payments are made to our corporate account at ICBC (Industrial and Commercial Bank of China).
pay.fullNote: Full account number is provided upon order confirmation.
pay.q1: Why do you require full advance payment?
pay.a1: Full advance payment allows us to secure the vehicle, complete all export documentation, and arrange shipping without delay. This is standard practice in the China vehicle export industry and enables us to offer the most competitive FOB pricing.
pay.a2: Yes. Every payment is backed by a formal sales contract with Incoterms 2020 terms. You receive a proforma invoice, commercial invoice, and all export documentation. Our ICBC business account is a verified corporate account under Chinese regulatory oversight.
pay.q3: What documents will I receive before payment?

log.khorgos3d: Almaty in 2–4 days, Tashkent in 10–14 days, Moscow and Yekaterinburg in 16–22 days.
log.khorgos4d: Full overland coverage — rail where speed and cost align, truck for the fastest door-side delivery in the region.

b2c.q2: Is the FOB price the same for single and bulk orders?
b2c.a2: The per-vehicle FOB price is the same; bulk fleets unlock volume freight discounts on the shipping side. Single orders pay our standard, transparent FOB rate.
b2c.q3: What exactly does FOB pricing include?
b2c.a3: The vehicle, the 200-point inspection, export documentation and port loading. Destination freight, insurance and duties are quoted separately based on your port.
b2c.q4: How do you verify vehicle history?
b2c.a4: We cross-reference Chinese domestic databases — insurance claim records, accident histories and annual roadworthiness tests — and provide the verified report with your order.
b2c.q5: How long does a single-vehicle order take?

chk.sub: The full standard covers 200 checkpoints. Here is the deepest part of it — the areas that decide whether a Chinese car is export-grade.
chk.title: The most thorough Chinese car check you can get
chk.engine.1d: Cylinder compression measured and compared across all cylinders, with leak-down testing where required.
chk.engine.2d: Timing chain condition, serpentine belts, turbo/supercharger health and cold-start behavior.
chk.engine.3d: Fluid levels, pressure tests and a full under-hood inspection for leaks or residue.
chk.battery.1d: SoH and SoC readouts verified with diagnostic tools and compared against the advertised figure.
chk.battery.2d: Cell-group voltage balancing checked, plus a real-world driving range test.
chk.battery.3d: AC/DC port function, charge-cycle test, cooling system and high-voltage cable inspection.
chk.chassis.1d: Laser-measured frame and sill straightness to rule out hidden structural damage.
chk.chassis.2d: Undercarriage rust and corrosion assessment focused on load-bearing zones.
chk.chassis.3d: Subframe condition, engine/gearbox mounts and exhaust system integrity.
chk.trans.1d: Manual, automatic or DCT gearbox operation, clutch take-up and gear-change feel.
chk.trans.2d: CV joints, driveshafts, differential whine and four-wheel-drive engagement.
chk.trans.3d: EV reducer condition, e-motor output and regenerative braking function.
chk.susp.1d: Shock absorber dampening, spring condition and test-drive ride quality.
chk.susp.2d: Brake pad thickness, rotor wear, caliper function and ABS/ESP diagnostics.
chk.susp.3d: Wheel alignment, steering feel, tie-rod ends and bushing condition.
chk.ext.1d: Paint thickness gauge readings on every panel to expose previous repainting.
chk.ext.2d: Panel gap alignment, original glass check and lighting function.
chk.ext.3d: Visible accident evidence, filler presence and trim fitment reviewed.
chk.int.1d: Seat, headliner and trim condition with wear and moisture checks.
chk.int.2d: Windows, seats, mirrors, infotainment, AC performance and OBD-II module scan.
chk.int.3d: Mileage cross-checked across ECUs, service records and inspection platforms.
chk.fluid.1d: Engine oil, coolant, brake and transmission fluid level and condition checks.
chk.fluid.2d: Tread depth, sidewall damage, wheel condition and spare tire presence.
chk.fluid.3d: 15-minute road test covering acceleration, braking, steering and NVH.
chk.docs.1d: VIN verified against registration documents and cross-checked with Chinese vehicle databases.
chk.docs.2d: Insurance claim records checked to exclude vehicles with undisclosed accidents or frame damage.
chk.docs.3d: Ownership, legal status and export eligibility confirmed before listing.
